AuditControlAssessmentState.description:
An auditor's assessment of a control within an audit. This is the full flat
union of every framework's assessment states (the superset); a given audit's
framework only uses its own subset. `NOT_ASSESSED` is shared by all
frameworks and is the default for a control that has not yet been assessed.

Which states apply to which framework:
- Most frameworks (e.g. SOC 2): `IN_PLACE`, `NOT_IN_PLACE`, `PARTIAL`, `NOT_ASSESSED`
- ISO 27001: `CONFORMING`, `MINOR_NON_CONFORMITY`, `MAJOR_NON_CONFORMITY`, `NOT_ASSESSED`
- FedRAMP: `SATISFIED`, `NOT_SATISFIED`, `OTHER_THAN_SATISFIED`, `NOT_ASSESSED`
- FedRAMP Key Security Indicators (KSI): `TRUE`, `FALSE`, `PARTIAL`, `NOT_ASSESSED`

Distinct from `ControlStatus`, which is the computed tests/documents-passing
status — a different concept.

a `null` justification.

email.description: Email address of the person - always present.

jobTitle.description: Job title from HR system, or null if not available.

employmentStatus.description: Employment status, or null if not available.

startDate.description:
Start date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if not available.

endDate.description: End date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if currently employed.

groups.description:

use an empty array when there are no groups.

source.description:
Source of user data, or null if not available.

taskStatus.description:
Overall task status information, or null if not available.
Full Audit View only - omitted in Controlled Audit View.

lastReminded.description:
Last date user was sent an onboarding reminder email in ISO 8601 format, or null if never reminded.

policies.description:
Policy acceptance task details, or null if not available.

trainings.description:
Security training task details, or null if not available.
Full Audit View only - omitted in Controlled Audit View.

backgroundChecks.description:
Background check task details, or null if not available.
Full Audit View only - omitted in Controlled Audit View.

deviceMonitoring.description:
Device monitoring task details, or null if not available.
Full Audit View only - omitted in Controlled Audit View.

customOnboarding.description:
Custom onboarding task details, or null if not available.
Full Audit View only - omitted in Controlled Audit View.

customOffboarding.description:
Custom offboarding task details, or null if not available.
Full Audit View only - omitted in Controlled Audit View.

AccountAccessService.description:
An account access service (identity provider, access credential, or external application)
connected to the organization.

These represent credentials for integrations like Okta, Azure AD,
Google Workspace, etc. that provide identity and access management
data for personnel, as well as external applications that provide
received user accounts.

id.description: Unique identifier for the service.

credentialDisplayName.description: Display name of the service shown to users.

service.description: The service name or integration ID.

subAccountId.description: Sub-account identifier for multi-account integrations, or null if not applicable.

AccountAccessStatus.description:
Account status values for account access records.
Unified status enum that covers all service types.

AccountAccess.description:
Account access record from personnel population.

This unified interface represents account access data from all service types:
- IDP services (Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, etc.)
- First-party account services (AWS, Azure, GCP, Oracle Cloud, etc.)
- Role grants services (GCP, Azure role grants)
- Received/third-party applications

Only `id` and `accountName` are always present. Other fields are optional so
disallowed columns can be omitted (for example under controlled audit view).
When an optional field is present, `null` means the column is visible but empty
(only fields that are nullable in population data use `null`).

id.description: Unique identifier for the account.

accountName.description: Account name or email address (primary identifier).

owner.description: Display name of the account owner, or null when the column is visible but unknown.

role.description: Account roles; empty array when the column is visible but has no roles.

status.description: Account status when present; omitted when the column is not in the response.

mfa.description:
Multi-factor authentication (MFA) status when present.
`true` = MFA enabled, `false` = MFA not enabled, `null` = visible but unknown.

createdDate.description: Account creation date when present, or null when visible but absent.

deactivatedDate.description: Account deactivation date when present, or null when active.

ComputerOwner.description: Identifier and display name for the personnel record that owns a device.

id.description: Personnel record id.

UnmonitoredReason.description:
Reasons the device's agent considers it unsupported (and therefore
unmonitored). Each flag is `true` when the corresponding reason applies.

Only populated for devices reported by an agent monitoring source; MDM and
connector reports leave this `null`.

unsupportedOsVersion.description: The device's OS version is below the agent's minimum supported version.

unsupportedOsType.description: The device's OS type is not supported by the agent.

unsupportedAgentVersion.description: The installed agent version is below the minimum supported version.

PersonnelComputer.description:
A monitored-computer record from the personnel population.

`id` is required. All other fields are optional to support customizable field
visibility under Controlled Audit View (CAV).

Omitted keys mean the column is not in the response; `null` means the column
is present but empty.

id.description: Unique identifier for the device.

deviceName.description: Display name of the device, or null if not reported.

osPlatform.description: Operating-system platform, or null if not reported.

osVersion.description: Operating-system version string, or null if not reported.

owner.description: The personnel record that owns the device, or null if unassigned.

monitoredBy.description:
Service that monitors the device. Reflects the primary monitoring source --
agents, MDM, or connectors (e.g. "macOS", "Windows", "Vanta D"). Null if
unmonitored.

passwordManager.description: Outcome of the password-manager compliance check (PW column).

hardDriveEncrypted.description: Outcome of the hard-drive-encryption compliance check (HD column).

antivirusInstalled.description: Outcome of the antivirus-installed compliance check (AV column).

screenlockEnabled.description: Outcome of the screenlock-enabled compliance check (SL column).

unmonitoredReason.description:
Reasons the device's agent considers it unsupported (and therefore
unmonitored). Only populated for agent-reported devices; null for MDM and
connector sources.

ComputerMonitoringService.description:
A service that can appear in the `monitoredBy` field of a personnel
computer record (and thus be used as a filter value via
`monitoredByMatchesAny` on the parent endpoint).

The set returned by this listing reflects the customer's currently
installed integrations -- it is dynamic, not a fixed enum, which is why
the filter parameter on the parent endpoint accepts free-form strings.

id.description:
Identifier to pass into the `monitoredByMatchesAny` query parameter on
`GET /audits/{auditId}/personnel/computers`. Matches the `monitoredBy`
field on a `PersonnelComputer` record exactly.

displayName.description:
Human-readable name for display. Sourced from the integration's
configured display name (or, for connectors, the external application's
name).

AuditOrganizationNotificationSubscriptio.description:
A single external-notification subscription row returned by the auditor
organization notifications API. Represents one mailing-list address +
notification-category pairing.

id.description: Subscription record identifier.

address.description: Email address that receives notifications for this category.

cadence.description:
Cadence of summary notifications for this subscription, or null for
non-summary (immediate / reminder) subscriptions.

unsubSettingsKey.description:
Notification category the subscription belongs to (e.g.
`SUMMARY_EMPLOYEE`, `NEW_VENDORS_DISCOVERED_EMAIL`,
`TRUST_REPORT_ACCESS_REQUEST_EMAIL`).

toggleIsSubscribed.description:
Whether the address is currently subscribed to receive this category's
notifications.

AuditOrganizationNotifications.description:
Organization notifications record returned by the auditor API.

Ad-hoc single-row payload per domain mirroring the shape of the
Organization → Notifications page. Only `id` is guaranteed; every other
field is optional because controlled audit views can strip any column
from the response.

id.description: Domain identifier of the audited organization.

preferredTimeZone.description:
IANA timezone identifier that determines when scheduled reminder
notifications are sent. `null` means the organization has no configured
preference ("Anytime" in the UI).

employeeDigestFrequency.description:
Frequency at which personnel reminder digests are sent (e.g. `DAILY`,
`WEEKLY`, or `NEVER`). `null` when no notification settings have been
configured for the organization.

subscribedChannelTypes.description:
Channels on which the personnel reminder digest is delivered (e.g.
`["EMAIL"]` or `["EMAIL", "SLACK"]`).

externalNotifications.description:
External notification subscriptions — one row per mailing-list address
plus category pairing. Covers Compliance, Vendors, Access Reviews, and
Trust Center categories.

AuditOrganizationCompanyLogo.description: Company logo reference for an organization.

url.description: URL to download the company logo.

AuditOrganizationInformation.description:
Organization information record returned by the auditor organization API.

`id` and `displayName` are always present (primary fields). Other fields
are optional to support controlled audits where only approved columns are
returned.

id.description: Business info document identifier.

incorporation.description:
Incorporation status. Returns "Incorporated in the United States"
when the organization is a US company, or null otherwise.

companyLogo.description: Company logo reference (download URL), or null if no logo is uploaded.

IssueSnapshotItemApprovalProgress.description: Approval progress for an issue at the time the snapshot was captured.

approvedCount.description: The number of approvers who have approved the issue.

totalApprovers.description: The total number of approvers in the issue's approval chain.

id.description:
The unique identifier for the snapshot of an issue.

This is distinct from the issueId, which identifies the underlying issue across snapshots.
The snapshot item ID is unique to this specific snapshot of the issue.

description.example: The following user accounts have passwords that do not meet the company's password policy: [list of accounts]. Weak passwords increase the risk of unauthorized access to systems and data.

readableIssueId.description:
The human-readable identifier for the issue.

This field is unique per-domain, and can be used to correlate
this issue snapshot item to the underlying issue across different snapshots.

issueId.description:
The globally unique identifier for the underlying issue across snapshots.

This field can be used to correlate this snapshot item to the underlying issue across different snapshots.

snapshotId.description: The identifier for the snapshot this issue item belongs to.

dueDate.description: The due date for the issue.

approvalProgress.description:
The issue's approval progress at the time the snapshot was captured,
or null if no approval was in progress or issue approvals are not enabled.

lastModifiedAt.description: The date and time when the issue was last modified.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the issue was created.

detectedAt.description: The date and time when the issue was detected.

IssueSnapshotItemOrderBy.description: Allowed values for the `orderBy` query parameter on issue snapshot item endpoints.

id.description: The unique identifier for the issue snapshot.

description.example: This snapshot captures all open issues as of June 1st, 2024.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the snapshot was created.

AuditIntegration.description:
Integration row returned by the auditor integrations API.

`id` and `name` are always present. Other fields are optional to support
controlled audits where only approved columns are returned.

id.description: Integration identifier.

tags.description: Integration tag display names describing what data this integration provides.

categories.description: Category display names describing what the integration is used for.

InformationRequestApprovalStatus.description:
Current approval status of the information request, tracking its lifecycle through the audit process.

The status progresses through the workflow: initial state → awaiting review → approved or flagged.
Status can move between awaiting review and flagged states as evidence is reviewed and resubmitted.

InformationRequestCadence.description: Frequency cadence for the information request, indicating how often it recurs.

InformationRequestType.description:
Type of information request, defining what scope of evidence is needed.

- POINT_IN_TIME: Evidence for a specific moment (e.g., current state of a policy)
- POPULATION: Evidence covering all items in a category (e.g., all employees)
- SAMPLE: Evidence for a representative sample (e.g., 10 random customer records)

ResourceOwner.description: Represents either a user or a team owning a resource.

InformationRequest.description:
Information Request resource representing a single request for audit evidence from a customer.

An information request is created by an auditor and shared with the customer organization.
The customer then uploads evidence, which the auditor reviews and either approves or flags
for issues.

id.description:
The unique identifier for the information request within Vanta's system.
This is the primary identifier used in all API endpoints.
Format: ObjectId as a string (e.g., "6890e473dce1da5d8406f5e7")

uniqueId.description:
External unique ID to prevent duplicates across different audit systems.
Used for idempotency when syncing data between external audit management
systems and Vanta. Unlike `id`, this value is provided by the external system.

additionalControlIds.description:
Additional control IDs beyond those automatically mapped from framework codes.
Allows manual association with specific controls when automatic mapping
is insufficient. Each ID should reference a valid control in your audit framework.

approvalStatus.description:
Current approval status tracking the request's lifecycle through evidence
submission and auditor review.

cadence.description:
How frequently this information request recurs (e.g., annual password
policy reviews). Null for one-time requests.

frameworkCodes.description:
Always empty on read. To find requests for a control, use
`GET /audits/{auditId}/controls/{controlId}/information-requests`.
For request assignment, use `segmentIds`.

segmentIds.description:
Audit segments this request is assigned to. Empty means unassigned.
Resolved against the current audit scope — stale IDs are dropped.

This field is a current-scope projection, not a stored watermark. An
audit-scope change that drops or adds IDs here does not update
creationDate, modificationDate, or deletionDate, so it does not appear in
`changedSinceDate` delta sync on its own. Re-fetch the list without that
parameter, or GET the request by id, to see the current projection.

description.description:
Detailed description explaining what evidence is needed and why.
Should provide clear instructions to help the customer understand what
to submit.

dueDate.description:
The deadline by which the customer must fulfill this request.
Null if no specific deadline is set. Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

evidenceCaptureDate.description:
The earliest date for which evidence should be captured.
Evidence dated before this date may not be accepted.
Null if not restricted. Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

requestId.description:
Non-unique external reference ID for this request.
Unlike `uniqueId` which must be unique, `requestId` is for display/reference
purposes only (e.g., "REQ-123"). Null if not provided.

requestType.description: Defines the scope of evidence required.

title.description: Short, descriptive title summarizing what is being requested.

creationDate.description:
Timestamp when the request was created in the system.
Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

modificationDate.description:
Timestamp when the request was last modified.
Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

deletionDate.description:
Timestamp when the request was soft-deleted. Null if the request has not
been deleted. Soft deletes allow retaining history while hiding the request
from normal operations.
Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

ownerAssignment.description:
Resource owner (user or team) assigned to this information request.
Returns null if no resource owner is assigned.

CreateInformationRequestInput.description:
Input for creating a new information request.
New requests are created in an initial state by default.

uniqueId.description:
External unique ID to prevent duplicate requests across audit systems.
Must be unique within the audit. Used for idempotency.

title.description:
Short, descriptive title summarizing what is being requested.
Must be at least 1 character.

description.description:
Detailed description explaining what evidence is needed.
Helps the customer understand what to submit. Optional.

frameworkCodes.description:
Framework codes this request addresses.
An empty array if no framework codes are associated.

cadence.description: How frequently this request recurs. Null or omitted for one-time requests.

dueDate.description:
Deadline for fulfilling this request. Null or omitted if no deadline.
Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

evidenceCaptureDate.description:
Start date of the audit period. Evidence before this date may not be accepted.
Null or omitted if not restricted.
Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

additionalControlIds.description:
Control IDs to link directly to this request, beyond those automatically
mapped from framework codes. Each must be the `id` of an existing control in
the customer's organization (the identifier returned by the controls endpoints).
The request is rejected if any ID does not match a control.
Omit or pass an empty array for no direct control links.

PartialUpdateInformationRequest.description:
Input for partially updating an information request. Only provided fields
will be updated; omitted fields remain unchanged. At least one field must
be provided.

frameworkCodes.description:
The framework codes this request addresses.
An empty array if no framework codes are associated.

description.description: Detailed description of what evidence is needed.

dueDate.description:
Deadline for fulfilling this request. Null if no deadline.
Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

evidenceCaptureDate.description:
Start date of the audit period. Evidence before this date may not be accepted.
Null if not restricted. Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

additionalControlIds.description:
Control IDs to link directly to this request, beyond those automatically
mapped from framework codes. Replaces the existing set: pass the complete
desired list, an empty array to clear all direct control links, or omit to
leave them unchanged. Each must be the `id` of an existing control in the
customer's organization (the identifier returned by the controls endpoints).
The request is rejected if any ID does not match a control.

FlagInformationRequestEvidenceInput.description:
Input for flagging evidence on an information request, indicating issues
that need to be addressed. This changes the request's approvalStatus to
a flagged state and creates an activity log entry.

The customer will be notified and can resubmit evidence after addressing the issues.

auditorEmail.description:
Email of the auditor flagging the evidence.
Must match an existing Vanta user who belongs to the audit firm making the API request.

reason.description:
Detailed explanation of what issues were found with the evidence.
This reason is visible to the customer and guides them on what to fix.
Must be at least 1 character.

AcceptInformationRequestEvidenceInput.description:
Input for accepting evidence on an information request, indicating that
the submitted evidence meets requirements. This changes the request's
approvalStatus to an approved state and creates an activity log entry.

auditorEmail.description:
Email of the auditor accepting the evidence.
Must match an existing Vanta user who belongs to the audit firm making the API request.

framework.description: Display name of the in-scope framework these codes belong to.

codes.description: Valid codes for this framework, sorted.

frameworkCodes.description: Valid framework codes for this audit.

codesByFramework.description:
Valid codes grouped by each distinct in-scope framework. A code that exists
on two frameworks appears in both groups. Two segments that share a
framework contribute one group. `framework` is the display name.

UploadedDocumentEvidence.description:
Evidence in the form of an uploaded document file.
The URL is a temporary presigned URL that expires after a certain period.

id.description: The unique identifier for the uploaded document in Vanta's system.

filename.description:
The original filename of the uploaded document.
Undefined if the filename was not captured during upload.

mimeType.description:
The MIME type of the document indicating its file format.
Common types: "application/pdf", "image/png", "image/jpeg", "text/plain"

url.description:
A presigned URL for downloading the document.
This URL is temporary and expires after a limited time.
Request a new evidence list to get a fresh URL if expired.

LinkEvidence.description: Evidence in the form of a link to external documentation or resources.

title.description: The title or descriptive name for the link.

description.description: Optional description providing additional context about the link.

url.description: The URL pointing to the external documentation or resource.

ObservationEvidence.description: Evidence in the form of a text observation or note.

observationDetails.description: The text content of the observation.

VantaDocumentUploadedEvidence.description:
Represents an uploaded file in a Vanta Document.
The file is stored in Vanta's system and accessed via a presigned URL.

type.description: Discriminator to identify this as an uploaded file.

id.description: The unique identifier for the file version in Vanta's system.

filename.description:
The original filename of the uploaded document.
Undefined if the filename was not captured during upload.

mimeType.description:
The MIME type of the document indicating its file format.
Common types: "application/pdf", "image/png", "image/jpeg", "text/plain"

url.description:
A presigned URL for downloading the document.
This URL is temporary and expires after a limited time.
Request a new evidence list to get a fresh URL if expired.

VantaDocumentLinkEvidence.description:
Represents an external link in a Vanta Document.
The link points to documentation hosted outside of Vanta's system.

type.description: Discriminator to identify this as an external link.

id.description: The unique identifier for the file version in Vanta's system.

url.description: The URL pointing to the external documentation or resource.

VantaDocumentEvidence.description:
Evidence in the form of a Vanta Document.
Vanta Documents are managed documents with metadata like expiration dates
and versioning. They can either be uploaded files stored in Vanta or
links to external documentation.

title.description: The title of the document as displayed in Vanta.

description.description: Optional description providing additional context about the document.

expirationDate.description:
The date when the document version expires and should be renewed.
Undefined if no expiration is set.
Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

addedBy.description:
Information about the user who added this file version to the document.
Undefined if the user information is not available.

documentVersionId.description: The unique identifier of the document version submitted as evidence.

file.description:
The file or link associated with this document version.
Use the `type` discriminator to determine whether it's an uploaded file
or an external link.

VantaPolicyEvidence.description:
Evidence in the form of a Vanta Policy.
Vanta Policies are compliance policies with metadata like locale,
effective dates, and versioning. Policies are always uploaded files
stored in Vanta's system.

title.description: The title of the policy as displayed in Vanta.

description.description: Optional description providing additional context about the policy.

expirationDate.description:
The date when the policy version expires and should be renewed.
Undefined if no expiration is set.
Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

lastEditedBy.description:
Information about the user who last edited this policy version.
Undefined if the user information is not available.

policyId.description:
The policy type this evidence belongs to (e.g. "information-security-policy-bsi").
Policies prefixed with "custom-" are customer-defined; others are Vanta-provided templates.

policyVersionId.description:
The identifier of the approved policy version that was submitted as evidence.
A new version is created each time a policy is updated and approved.

policyVersionFileId.description:
The identifier of the locale-specific file within the policy version.
Each policy version may contain multiple files, one per supported language.

effectiveOrCreationDate.description:
The date when this policy version became effective, or when it was created.
Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

locale.description:
The locale/language of the policy document.
Examples: "EN" for English, "ES" for Spanish, "FR" for French

url.description:
A presigned URL for downloading the policy document.
This URL is temporary and expires after a limited time.
Request a new evidence list to get a fresh URL if expired.

mimeType.description:
The MIME type of the policy document indicating its file format.
Common types: "application/pdf", "application/msword"

filename.description:
The original filename of the uploaded policy document.
Undefined if the filename was not captured during upload.

id.description: The unique identifier for the uploaded policy file in Vanta's system.

file.description: The uploaded policy file for this version.

VantaTestEvidence.description:
Evidence in the form of a Vanta automated test run.
Vanta Tests are automated compliance tests with metadata like test status,
execution time, and file type. Tests generate evidence files that can be
workpapers, raw data, or API request logs.

title.description: The title of the test run as displayed in Vanta.

testId.description: The unique identifier for the test in Vanta's system.

snapshotId.description:
The unique identifier for the point-in-time capture of this test run's evidence.
A snapshot is an immutable record of all files (workpapers, raw data, etc.)
generated during a single test execution.

testRunStatus.description: The outcome status of the test run.

executedAt.description:
The date and time when the test was executed.
Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

fileType.description: The type of evidence file included in this evidence.

mimeType.description:
The MIME type of the evidence file.
Common types: "application/pdf" for workpapers, "text/csv" for raw data

url.description:
A presigned URL for downloading the evidence file.
This URL is temporary and expires after a limited time.
Request a new evidence list to get a fresh URL if expired.

file.description: The evidence file for this test run.

VantaTestSnapshotEvidence.description:
Evidence in the form of a Vanta automated test run snapshot.

Unlike VantaTestEvidence (which represents a single file within a test run's
evidence packet), a snapshot represents the entire test-run bundle. Use the
dedicated snapshot detail endpoint to retrieve the files associated with a
snapshot.

snapshotId.description:
The unique identifier for the point-in-time capture of this test run's evidence.
A snapshot is an immutable record of all files (workpapers, raw data, etc.)
generated during a single test execution.

testId.description: The unique identifier for the test in Vanta's system.

testRunId.description: The unique identifier for the test run this snapshot was captured from.

testRunTitle.description: The title of the test run as displayed in Vanta.

testRunStatus.description: The outcome status of the test run.

testRunExecutedAt.description:
The date and time when the test was executed.
Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

InformationRequestEvidenceUnion.description:
Union type representing the different forms of evidence content.
The specific type is determined by the `evidenceType` field in InformationRequestEvidence.

id.description:
The unique identifier for the evidence within Vanta's system.
Format: ObjectId as a string (e.g., "6890e473dce1da5d8406f5e7").

evidenceType.description:
Type of evidence attached to this information request.
Determines the structure of the `evidence` field.

visibleToAuditorDate.description:
Timestamp when the evidence was made visible to the auditor.
Null if the customer has not yet shared this evidence with the auditor.
Evidence must be shared before the auditor can review it.
Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

creationDate.description:
Timestamp when the evidence was created/uploaded.
Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

modificationDate.description:
Timestamp when the evidence was last modified.
Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

deletionDate.description:
Timestamp when the evidence was soft-deleted.
Null if the evidence has not been deleted.
Soft deletes retain evidence in the system for audit history while hiding
it from normal operations.
Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

evidence.description: The evidence content. Structure varies based on evidenceType.

VantaTestSnapshotIntegration.description: Integration metadata for a test, mirroring the Vanta web app.

VantaTestSnapshotRawTestDataRow.description:
One row of raw test data attached to a snapshot.

For structured snapshots, every row carries the resource refs and the raw
JSON for that resource. For unstructured snapshots, a single row is returned
with `resourceId` and `resourceType` set to `null` and `rawJson` containing
the entire test-run JSON blob.

resourceId.description:
Identifier of the underlying resource the row was captured from. Null for
unstructured snapshots, which do not partition by resource.

resourceType.description:
Specific resource kind for the row (e.g. `AwsIamUser`). Null for
unstructured snapshots.

rawJson.description:
Raw JSON payload as emitted by the test runner. Shape varies by
`resourceType` for structured snapshots and matches the full test-run
blob for unstructured snapshots.

VantaTestSnapshotOutOfScopeResources.description:
Resources excluded from the test at snapshot time, grouped by exclusion
reason.  `testLevel` contains resources the customer disabled for the
test; `frameworkLevel` contains resources scoped out by the framework's
segment configuration.

VantaTestSnapshotApiRequest.description: A single API request captured during an API introspection test run.

VantaTestSnapshotEvidenceDetail.description:
Detail response for a captured automated-test snapshot evidence row.

Combines the test-level metadata (description, integrations, SLA
remediation) with a uniform raw-data array so external clients see the
same shape regardless of whether the snapshot was structured or
unstructured.

testId.description: The unique identifier for the test in Vanta's system.

testName.description: The display name of the test.

description.description: A short description of what the test checks.

evaluationCriteria.description: Longer-form, formatted description of the test. Null when unset.

integrations.description: Integrations whose data feeds the test.

slaRemediation.description: SLA remediation policy attached to the test, or null when no SLA is set.

rawTestData.description: Raw test data captured at snapshot time.

outOfScopeResources.description:
Resources excluded from the test at snapshot time. Absent when the
snapshot data could not be loaded; clients should treat a missing
field as "unknown" rather than "nothing excluded".

apiRequests.description:
API requests captured during the test run. Absent when the snapshot
data could not be loaded. Empty array when the test does not perform
API introspection.

InformationRequestComment.description:
A comment on an information request enables communication between auditors
and customers regarding evidence requirements and submissions.

These threaded discussions help clarify requests, explain or resolve questions about evidence,
and are always visible to both parties once created.

id.description:
The unique identifier for the comment within Vanta's system.
Format: ObjectId as a string (e.g., "6890e473dce1da5d8406f5e7").

text.description:
The comment message content.
Can include explanations, questions, or clarifications about the information request.

creationDate.description:
Timestamp when the comment was created.
Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

modificationDate.description:
Timestamp when the comment was last edited.
Null if the comment has never been modified.
Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

deletionDate.description:
Timestamp when the comment was soft-deleted.
Null if the comment has not been deleted.
Soft deletes retain the comment for audit history while hiding it from normal operations.
Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

email.description:
Email address of the comment author.
This email uniquely identifies users between Vanta and external audit systems.
Null when the comment author can't be matched to a Vanta user.
